statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-20, Qatar and Iran issue public statements that converge on a single account of the fate of the three Iranian pilots Qatar allegedly shot down in March 2026, either confirming them alive and held or confirming their deaths.
resolution: TRUE if Qatar and Iran state the same outcome for the three named pilots, reported by Reuters, AP, or AFP, between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-20; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if Qatar's denial and Iran's captivity claim both remain unretracted and unreconciled through the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15, the United States government takes a formal, documented action asserting a sovereignty or territorial claim over any part of the Strait of Hormuz, beyond rhetorical statements by the President.
resolution: TRUE if the Federal Register, a State Department notice, or a wire service reports a formal US filing or action claiming sovereignty over Hormuz waters between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if no formal US filing, order, or notification asserting a Hormuz sovereignty claim occurs within the window.

statement: On 2026-08-19, Target Corporation common stock closes with a single-session price change of 5.0 percent or greater, up or down, relative to its 2026-08-18 close, following its Q2 fiscal 2026 earnings release that morning.
resolution: TRUE if TGT closing price on 2026-08-19 differs from its 2026-08-18 close by 5.0 percent or more in either direction, per NYSE consolidated closing data; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if the TGT close on 2026-08-19 differs from the prior close by less than 5.0 percent.

statement: WTI crude oil does not settle above 90.00 USD per barrel on the NYMEX on any trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: TRUE if the NYMEX WTI daily settlement price stays at or below 90.00 USD/bbl on every trading day from 2026-08-17 through 2026-09-15; FALSE if any settlement exceeds 90.00.
failure_condition: MISS if the WTI settlement price exceeds 90.00 USD/bbl on any trading day in the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31, a cybersecurity vendor or outlet other than BleepingComputer, such as Krebs on Security, The Hacker News, Malwarebytes, SentinelOne, or Objective-See, publishes independent research naming and attributing the AmnesiaStealer macOS malware campaign.
resolution: TRUE if a named second security vendor or outlet publishes independent attribution of AmnesiaStealer between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if the AmnesiaStealer campaign receives no independent second-source attribution within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-20, the US Navy or Department of Defense publicly confirms that USS George Washington has relieved USS Abraham Lincoln on its Middle East deployment station.
resolution: TRUE if DoD or Navy public affairs, or a wire service citing an on-record defense official, confirms the Lincoln to George Washington handover between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-20; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if the Lincoln to George Washington handover is not officially confirmed within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31, Chesterfield County Police or Virginia State University publicly identify and announce the arrest of a second suspect, beyond Camron Harris, in the August 15, 2026 shooting outside VSU residence halls.
resolution: TRUE if Chesterfield County Police or VSU announce and name the arrest of an additional suspect between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31, reported by a wire service or local outlet; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if no additional named suspect is arrested in the VSU shooting within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31, Zimbabwean authorities or a wire service report a confirmed death toll from the August 2026 Zimbabwe boat accident greater than 68.
resolution: TRUE if a wire service or Zimbabwean government statement reports a confirmed death toll above 68 for this accident between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if the confirmed death toll does not exceed 68 within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-24, the USGS earthquake catalog records at least one aftershock of magnitude 5.0 or greater within 100 km of the August 16, 2026 M7.7 Ende, Indonesia earthquake, USGS event id us6000tkt2.
resolution: TRUE if USGS ComCat lists an M5.0 or greater event within 100 km of event us6000tkt2 dated between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-24; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if no M5.0 or greater aftershock within 100 km of the epicenter occurs within the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-24, the High Fens wildfire burns across the Belgium-Germany border into confirmed German territory.
resolution: TRUE if a German civil-protection authority or a wire service confirms the fire crossed into German territory between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-24; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: MISS if the wildfire does not cross into confirmed German territory within the window.
